title: fix round 1 (merge conflict) for held T-1725: rebase task/T-1725 onto goal/T-1705 keeping both post_cmd (T-1730) and max_parallel in gate.settings
spec:
Merge-conflict round for T-1725 (gates on a background worker). The merge queue could not rebase task/T-1725 (head c00a914, two commits c24a671 + c00a914 on top of 2f94453) onto goal/T-1705 (head 89d0978) because T-1730 (cb59f92, gate post_cmd after every attempt) landed there first and edits the same lines of gate.settings(). T-1725 was gated green (295 tests) and review-approved at c00a914; the code is right, only the rebase is missing.

Work in /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/T-1725 on branch task/T-1725 (worktree is clean). No fetch needed, local refs only. Run `git rebase goal/T-1705` and resolve every conflict by keeping BOTH sides' intent; the recorded conflicts are exactly two files:

1. orchestrator/gate.py, settings(): keep T-1730's post_cmd block (post_cmd = gate_cfg.get("post_cmd"); non-string or empty -> None) AND T-1725's max_parallel block (int >= 1, bool and invalid values fall back to 1). The returned dict carries all of: timeout_s, cleanup_cmd, cleanup_timeout_s, post_cmd, max_parallel.
2. tests/test_gate_timeout.py, test_settings_defaults_and_override: the defaults assertion expects both "post_cmd": None and "max_parallel": 1; the override config sets post_cmd "true" and max_parallel 3 and the assertion expects both; keep T-1725's invalid-value loop for max_parallel (0, -1, 1.5, "2", True -> 1) and the existing timeout_s loop.

If further hunks appear in other files, keep both sides the same way (goal side = T-1730/T-1716/T-1711/T-1709 behaviour, task side = T-1725's worker/reaper/registry). Do not drop any of T-1725's eight named tests and do not change behaviour beyond conflict resolution. Any caller of gate.settings() on the goal side that reads post_cmd must still get it after the rebase (grep post_cmd in orchestrator/gate.py and orchestrator/daemon.py).

Finish with the branch rebased (git log task/T-1725 shows goal/T-1705 head 89d0978 as an ancestor, no merge commit, no conflict markers), then run:
PYTHONPATH=tests uv run python -m unittest tests.test_daemon tests.test_gate_timeout tests.test_merge
If the rebase needed any code edit beyond marker resolution, commit it as a separate commit on task/T-1725 with a message naming the cause. Report the new head sha and the failures-only test output.
acceptance: task/T-1725 is rebased onto goal/T-1705 head 89d0978: `git merge-base --is-ancestor goal/T-1705 task/T-1725` exits 0 and `git grep -n '<<<<<<<' task/T-1725 -- orchestrator tests` finds nothing

gate.settings({}) returns post_cmd None and max_parallel 1; gate.settings with post_cmd "true" and max_parallel 3 returns both, and invalid max_parallel values fall back to 1 (test_settings_defaults_and_override)

the eight T-1725 tests in tests/test_daemon.py still exist and pass (test_gate_runs_in_background_and_tick_returns, test_gate_result_applied_by_reaper_green_red_timeout, test_gate_worker_exception_holds_gated_error, test_gate_max_parallel_and_same_worktree, test_cap_skip_does_not_count_attempt, test_sweep_extends_live_gate_lease, test_restart_clears_orphaned_gate_marker_and_regates, test_gated_at_not_stamped_at_start)

result.summary:
I rebased task/T-1725 onto goal/T-1705 (head 89d0978). The new head is `f7220ed`, and the three named test modules pass: 298 tests, OK.

- **How:** I did the rebase in this worktree on task/T-1739, which started at the same commit c00a914. Then I moved task/T-1725 to the result with `git reset --keep` in the clean wt/T-1725 worktree. A fast-forward wasn't possible because the rebase rewrote both commits. Both branches now sit at `f7220ed`.
- **Conflict fixes:** I only merged the conflict markers, and those fixes are inside the rebased `a8c2ffb`, so there is no separate commit.
  - In `orchestrator/gate.py`, `settings()` now keeps T-1730's post_cmd check and T-1725's max_parallel check, and returns timeout_s, cleanup_cmd, cleanup_timeout_s, post_cmd and max_parallel.
  - In `tests/test_gate_timeout.py`, `test_settings_defaults_and_override` expects both post_cmd and max_parallel in the defaults and the override, and keeps the invalid max_parallel loop and the timeout_s loop.
- **Checks:**
  - `git merge-base --is-ancestor goal/T-1705 task/T-1725` exits 0.
  - The conflict-marker grep finds nothing.
  - All eight T-1725 tests are still in `tests/test_daemon.py`.
  - The goal side's post_cmd handling in `gate.py` is unchanged, so callers still get post_cmd. `daemon.py` doesn't read it.

Files changed (conflict resolution only): `orchestrator/gate.py`, `tests/test_gate_timeout.py`

Failures-only test output: (empty)

Nothing is left to do here. The daemon runs the full gate.
